description: This file implements a React component for a page where users can upload resumes, job descriptions, and performance reviews, connect LinkedIn, and proceed to generate a professional persona. It manages state related to uploaded documents, provides UI for file uploads, and handles navigation to the next step.

classes.name: SuccessFileCard
classes.description: Component displaying a successfully uploaded file with options to remove it.

classes.name: UploadCard
classes.description: Component that renders a card interface for uploading a specific document type.

classes.name: BuildProfileStepPage
classes.description: Default exported React component for the build profile page, managing upload states and navigation.

methods.name: kindLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for each document kind.

methods.name: kindHelp
methods.description: Provides instructions for uploading each document type.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats byte sizes into human-readable strings.

methods.name: upsertDoc
methods.description: Adds or updates a document's metadata in the persona flow state.

methods.name: removeKind
methods.description: Removes a document of a specified kind from the persona flow state.

methods.name: getDocForKind
methods.description: Retrieves the uploaded document metadata for a specific kind.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the component's state from the persona flow state.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Sets an error message and triggers a visual shake effect.
